caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sewing table with a rectangular top and a drawer featuring two round metal handles and a keyhole in the center. The top and sides of the table are rendered in brown, indicating a polished wood surface. The table stands on four slender, tapered legs that are colored in a light beige tone, with the top portions of the front legs featuring a turned design. Hanging from the underside of the drawer is a gathered, fabric-lined basket in a prominent deep pink or red color with a floral or damask pattern. The background of the drawing is plain, with a lightly-finished beige color, and the table is centrally positioned within a faintly-outlined rectangular border. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Sewing Table
